summary: Antares Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K announcing a regular distribution of $0.1880 per share payable to shareholders of record as of July 28, 2026, and paid on or about August 31, 2026. The filing also disclosed net asset value (NAV) per share of $24.59 and aggregate NAV of approximately $809.2 million as of June 30, 2026, along with portfolio and leverage metrics. The company provided an update on its continuous public offering of up to $2.0 billion in shares, with 32,902,802 Class I shares issued for total consideration of $823,809,878 through the July 1, 2026 subscription date. This is a routine distribution and NAV disclosure, not a special-situation event.
